name: intelligent-context
description: Connects VS Code to a local Intelligent Context proxy: auto-discovers your configured models, injects project context, and sends workspace/project hints with every request.

commands.title: Intelligent Context: Clear Stored API Key

intelligentContext.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of your Intelligent Context proxy. This is the authoritative value — the "Configure Connection" command writes here too. The extension appends `/v1/models` and `/v1/chat/completions` (or `/v1/messages` for Anthropic-format models). Set this to a hostname or IP if the proxy runs on another machine.

intelligentContext.apiKeyHint.description: Show a one-time prompt to enter the proxy API key when the extension activates and no key is stored yet. The key is kept in VS Code's encrypted secret storage.

intelligentContext.sendWorkspaceContext.description: Send the workspace root, workspace name, current file, and active git branch as X-IC-* headers so the proxy can attribute requests to the right project.

intelligentContext.modelRefreshIntervalM.description: Poll the proxy's model list on this interval, in minutes. Set to 0 to disable polling (use "Refresh Model List" manually).

intelligentContext.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single chat request, in milliseconds.

intelligentContext.maxOutputTokensOverri.description: Override the output-token ceiling reported by the proxy. Set to 0 to use the proxy's value.
